name: MedlinePlus (NLM)

name: WHO
license_status: usually CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO: non-commercial; verify

name: NHS website (UK)
license_status: check NHS website content licence and API terms before ingest

name: NICE guidelines
license_status: check NICE reuse terms; commercial reuse may need permission

name: ESHRE guidelines
license_status: guidelines free to read; verify reuse

name: StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf)
license_status: CC BY-NC-ND: non-commercial, no derivatives; probably unsuitable to rewrite/chunk for a commercial app; verify

name: PubMed Central open access (CC BY subset)
license_status: only articles with CC BY-style licences

name: Egyptian Ministry of Health and Population
MSD Manuals Arabic (consumer version)
license_status: copyrighted (Merck); page on menstrual disorders and abnormal uterine bleeding exists in Arabic; link-only unless licensed

name: WHO Unified Medical Dictionary (English-Arabic)
license_status: terminology reference (5th ed., 200k+ entries); check terms of use before bulk export

name: MedlinePlus Arabic translations
license_status: Arabic coverage is partial; verify each page

name: Egyptian Knowledge Bank
license_status: access to licensed journals/books for Egyptian users; ingestion into an app is NOT covered; use for the reviewer's research

name: Commercial Arabic health sites and news articles (telehealth Q&A sites, news outlets republishing Mayo Clinic)
license_status: commercial copyrighted content; do NOT ingest or paraphrase closely
